notes: Posted 14 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(9)': the objective (posted 'ProfitDestroyed'), Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Han Solo, Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace and The Camp; these count toward the 60. The Camp is an Effect, not named as the starting Effect, so starting effect is left empty.

Posted 'ProfitDestroyed' dested You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed; 'Jabbas Palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Junland Wastes' dested Tatooine: Jundland Wastes (Official Tournament Sealed Deck), the only Light printing.

Posted 'Obi Padawans' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner; 'Han wBlaster' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Leia wBlaster' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Lando wAxe' Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Jedi Luke' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Orrimarko' Orrimaarko; 'Houijix' Houjix.
Posted 'Take Me to Jabba Now' dested You Will Take Me To Jabba Now; 'Clash Sabers' Clash Of Sabers; 'Projection' Projection Of A Skywalker; Weapon Levitation the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt.
Posted 'Luke's Blade', 'Qui Gon's Blade' and 'Obi's Blade' dested Luke's Lightsaber, Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber and Obi-Wan's Lightsaber.
'Puple Card(1)' is a section heading (the purple Podracing card) for I Did It!, which dested the Epic Event I Did It!.
